description_en: You can create and deploy a service instance by specifying parameters such as the region ID, service ID, and service version
description_zh: 通过指定地域ID、服务ID、服务版本等参数，创建并部署服务实例
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier create-service-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id service-0e6fca6a51a544200000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServiceInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou)

ap-southeast-1: Singapore
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。可能的值：

cn-hangzhou：华东1（杭州） 。

ap-southeast-1：新加坡
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the service instance. The name must meet the following requirements:

It can be up to 64 characters in length.

It must start with a letter or a digit and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例名称。格式要求如下：

长度不超过64个字符。

必须以数字或英文字母开头，可包含数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The parameters used to deploy the service instance.

If the service instance includes information about the deployment region, specify that information in the deployment parameters
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例部署的参数。

若服务实例包含部署地域信息，则需在部署参数中填写
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The token can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the template. Specify this parameter if the service supports multiple templates
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称，服务支持多模板时需要指定模板名称
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the specification package
parameters.name: specification_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. A dry run checks for permissions and instance status. Valid values:

true: The system checks the request but does not create the service instance.

false: The system sends the request. If the request passes the check, the service instance is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。可能的值：

true：发送请求，不创建服务实例。

false：发送请求，检查通过后创建服务实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The time when the service instance is released.

Only service providers can set this parameter for their own service instances in managed scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例的释放时间。

仅支持托管版场景中，服务商对自己的服务实例设置该参数
parameters.name: end_time

ServiceInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the service instance

Status.description_en:
The status of the service instance. Valid values:

Created: The service instance is created.

Deploying: The service instance is being deployed.

DeployedFailed: The service instance failed to be deployed.

Deployed: The service instance is deployed.

Upgrading: The service instance is being upgraded.

Deleting: The service instance is being deleted.

Deleted: The service instance is deleted.

DeletedFailed: The service instance failed to be deleted
Status.description_zh:
服务实例状态。可能值：

Created：已创建。

Deploying：部署中。

DeployedFailed：部署失败。

Deployed：已部署。

Upgrading：升级中。

Deleting：删除中。

Deleted：已删除。

DeletedFailed：删除失败
